text:
Shayne Gostisbehere is having the kind of season the defending champions need from him: 19 points in 25 games, nine on the power play, and a headline from Heavy.com noting he's approaching career-best production. Over his last ten games he has ten points, nine of them assists, against about 6.6 our numbers expected.

Some of this is real. Carolina takes about 65% of the shot attempts and expected goals at five on five with him on the ice, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him among the league's better setup defensemen last season. Some of it is not. The Hurricanes are scoring about ten more goals than their chances suggest with him on the ice, and Evolving-Hockey notes he plays with unusually strong teammates.

So enjoy the assists, but expect the pace to settle. His shooting is perfectly normal (three goals on three expected); it's the teammates' finishing around him that is running hot.
headline: Gostisbehere is riding a very friendly ice sheet
